summary: Bottom tab bar fix verified on 390x844 mobile viewport. All 5 tabs (Summary, Device, Flights, Sports, Weather) render at y=787 with height=49 (bottom=836, within viewport 844) and are fully tappable. Tapping each tab switches screens with no red-screen/console errors. Flights ZIP input accepts '10001' and persists. Tab bar remains visible after scrolling to end of both Flights and Sports screens (paddingBottom insets.bottom + 190 gives clearance). No regression observed. Native-only hints (BLE / adsb.lol / ESPN) intentionally not flagged as bugs per agent-to-agent context.
critical_code_review_comments: app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx correctly uses useSafeAreaInsets and sets tabBarStyle.height = 64 + insets.bottom and paddingBottom = insets.bottom + 8, resolving the reported home-indicator overlap on tall phones. On web insets.bottom=0 keeping height=64.
sports.tsx and flights.tsx both apply contentContainerStyle paddingBottom: insets.bottom + 190, giving comfortable clearance above the tab bar (no content hidden behind it).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tab bar fix (safe-area inset in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx) confirmed working. To interact with tab bar in Expo Router web, tabs render as <a role='tab'> not role='button'. Use selector '[role="tab"]' filtered by trailing text (endsWith name) since each tab's innerText contains icon glyph unicode + '\n' + label. Playwright get_by_role('button', name=...) will NOT match; use page.evaluate to click by innerText match, or query '[role="tab"]'.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: tabBarStyle.height was hard-coded to 64 with paddingBottom:8, so on iPhones with a home indicator the tab buttons rendered under the system gesture bar. Fix adds insets.bottom to both height and paddingBottom via useSafeAreaInsets(), pushing the touch targets above the safe area. Verified on mobile web viewport 390x844 (insets.bottom=0) that behavior remains correct (height=64, bottom=836).
